description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) attached to planning permission PL/1977/24 dated 12/11/2024 for Alterations and extension to create first floor level and basement to bungalow; Two dormers on front elevation; External alterations and landscaping
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition 2 on approved application reference PL/1977/24 dated 12/11/2024. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

Arboricultural Impact Assessment dated 17/03/2021 (Ref. AIA 7620)

Cover Letter dated 02.12.25 (Ref.1161)

Design & Access Statement dated June 2024,

Environmental Impact Assessment dated 16/0/2024 (Ref. 1161)

Existing Elevations (Front and Rear),

Existing Elevations (Side Elevation),

Existing Ground Floor Plan,

Existing House External Photographs,

Existing Roof Plan,

Existing Site Plan,

Fire Safety Statement (Ref. 1161),

Heritage Statement (Ref. 1161),

Level 1 Flood Risk Assessment August 2022 (Ref. 91973 Revision C)

Location Plan,

Proposed Basement Plan,

Proposed Elevations (Front and Rear) Revision B,

Proposed Elevations (Side Elevation) Revision E,

Proposed Elevations (Front Elevation ‘From Pavement’ and Section AA) Revision D,

Proposed First Floor Plan,

Proposed Ground Floor Plan Revision C,

Proposed Lower Ground Floor Plan - Fire Strategy; Proposed Ground

Floor Plan – Fire Strategy; Proposed First Floor Plan – Fire Strategy;

Proposed Roof Plan,

Proposed Site Plan,

Site Plan Showing Existing and Proposed Footprint (dated 01.12.2025),

TCP 7620.

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of surface water attenuation and storage works (9422-DR001 Rev SC001, 9422-100B, 9422-101 Rev B) as approved under PL/0206/25 dated 08/04/2025.</p>
<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the levels details (1100_00_02, 1161_10_00, 1161_01_11, 1161_20_03) as approved under PL/0206/25 dated 08/04/2025.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of retained trees and hedgerows on site and the measures for their protection shall be implemented and retained during construction works (1100_00_02) as approved under PL/0650/25 dated 16/05/2025.</p>

<p>Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities. Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site. The landscaping details shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and retained.</p>

<p>The roof area of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.</p>
